title: The Canopy Where Pages Become Wind

features.name: reading-station
features.desc-on-touch: A frame where pages were being read before they learned to fly. The grid still holds the memory of stillness.

features.name: page-fragment-ascending
features.desc-on-touch: A piece of text caught mid-dispersal. The data still remembers being pages; the wind has already claimed it.

features.name: stacked-pages
features.desc-on-touch: Pages climbing. Each one learns from the one below that air can hold you differently than shelves can.

features.name: text-becoming-current
features.desc-on-touch: Words in the wind. The archive wrote them. Now the wind reads them. The direction of understanding has reversed.

features.name: directory-of-flight
features.desc-on-touch: A library catalog rendered as departure records. Every title is a route the pages took into the blue.

inscription: here the library learned that wind is a kind of reading; pages in motion are the text that the air has always been singing

file.name: PageWind_SpectrumAnalysis_Ascending.txt
file.note: a list of library holdings as they were recorded becoming airborne, frequencies matching the moment of release

exits.label: where the library is still growing instead of standing
the current above the canopy where words learn wind-speech
the drift chamber where pages pool before they scatter
the orchard where things that grow learn to fall
